question: From which knot do the three aspects proceed in this teaching?
premises: The reference point is the brahma knot
The teaching is addressed to the beautiful-faced one
inference: The three aspects proceed from the brahma knot
uncertainties: The exact referent of etāṃ and trīṇi depends on context
plain_english: Situated from the brahma knot, these are indeed three, O beautiful-faced one.
